title: Dynamic Programming for Value-at-Risk Markov Decision Processes in Continuous Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.24439v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) is a widely adopted quantile-based risk measure in practice, yet incorporating VaR objectives into Markov decision processes (VaR MDPs) remains a longstanding challenge. Recent work has derived dynamic programming equations for VaR MDPs in finite state and action spaces but left the case of more general spaces unresolved. This paper establishes, for the first time, the validity of these equations in continuous spaces, for both finite- and infinite-horizon settings. Such cases naturally arise in many real-world dynamic decision-making problems. As an application, we study an optimal execution problem with a VaR objective and demonstrate that our framework enables the characterization of optimal dynamic strategies, resolving an open question in the field.

translated_title: 连续空间中风险价值马尔可夫决策过程的动态规划
translated_abstract: 风险价值是实践中广泛采用的基于分位数的风险度量方法，然而将VaR目标纳入马尔可夫决策过程（VaR MDP）仍然是一个长期存在的挑战。近期的工作已经在有限状态和动作空间中推导出了VaR MDP的动态规划方程，但更一般空间的情况尚未解决。本文首次在连续空间中证明了这些方程的有效性，涵盖了有限时域和无限时域两种设定。这类情形在许多现实世界的动态决策问题中自然出现。作为应用，我们研究了具有VaR目标的最优执行问题，并证明我们的框架能够刻画最优动态策略，解决了该领域一个悬而未决的问题。
tldr: 本文首次证明了风险价值马尔可夫决策过程的动态规划方程在连续空间中（包括有限和无限时域）的有效性，并将其应用于带VaR目标的最优执行问题，解决了该领域的开放性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes for the first time the validity of dynamic programming equations for Value-at-Risk Markov Decision Processes in continuous spaces for both finite- and infinite-horizon settings, and applies this framework to an optimal execution problem with a VaR objective, resolving an open question in the field.
